registering with The Groves following our move, the admin team misplaced one of my children’s red books. I eventually got it back only after going into the practice and asking them to look for it.

A couple of months later, my son had an allergic reaction to a wasp sting. When I called The Groves, the admin staff claimed they had no registration forms for him and refused to help. I contacted our previous GP, who assisted immediately due to the urgency of the situation. They later confirmed that The Groves did have our registration forms, as they had transferred the files to them over a month earlier. Only after I provided proof of the transfer did The Groves staff admit that they had made a mistake and failed to register us properly. Unfortunately, this was not the first time the admin team had given me inaccurate information.

We then experienced another issue involving my daughter. We called ahead to request the items needed for a treatment that had to be administered on specific days. We also followed up to confirm everything was prepared. However, on the day of the appointment, we were informed that the items had not been ordered, resulting in an unnecessary delay. The doctor was not at fault—this was yet another administrative error.

After a series of similar issues with the admin team, we have decided to move our family to a different local GP. Based on our experience, I cannot recommend The Groves. The administrative processes have been consistently unreliable, and we have lost confidence in their ability.",null,[0,202]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214WmJXbHJjWHBQWmxwMFdteDVjMEpXWmtOa2JrRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x2aea94dd26bb8eae!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmxZbWlrcXpPZlp0Wmx5c0JWZkNkbkE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT214WmJXbHJjWHBQWmxwMFdteDVjMEpXWmtOa2JrRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjtrbCj67KTAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0QoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjtrbCj67KTAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0Q0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDVyYWsxRk9WOWZSV2hFVjJoU1JrUkZSMkpqYjBaSk5GTklWVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRTkVOWk1sTk5kMVF3V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25KVFEwYzBjbk5PVXpkWVZUUkNMWFpxYkZVdFdHYxAB",["0x0:0x2aea94dd26bb8eae",null,1771608812611483,1771608812611483,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/100526726892022124201/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Jen","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIdvwVHxzi51Em-R1pFZtdOfNHrJcW33V_Pv2lN1eKnzE4vdtI=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/100526726892022124201?hl=en"],"100526726892022124201",null,15,0,null,[1,4,1],1,["Local Guide · 15 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjtrbCj67KTAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0Q7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[2],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Consistently late appointments with poor communication.
